''See also: [[Violet Light Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Violet]] [[Light]] is a powerful and difficult-to-summon magical force associated with the concept of absolute honesty. It manifests physically as shimmering, paper-thin sheets or strips of purple light that can act like bandages or nets to ensnare creatures, clear obstacles such as ice, or banish entities back to their original territories to restore global balance. Beyond its physical utility, the [[Violet]] [[Light]] possesses a sentient, communicative quality, often speaking to [[Alin]] in a cheerful manner or whispering truths. While it serves as a tool for protection and correction, its commitment to truth is uncompromising, often prioritizing honesty over mercy, compassion, or empathy. As [[Alin]] utilizes this power, it becomes an intrinsic part of his being, though its blunt revelations can be critical, questioning his humanity and morality.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Violet]] [[Light]] is a form of light residing within [[Alin]] that communicates with him by asking questions and providing ruthless honesty. This entity can show individuals their own appearance in a mirror-like fashion and falls like a luminescent blanket. It functions as a tool for correcting the world's balance by banishing objects back to their home [[Territory]] using sheets of light. While [[Alin]] can summon the light with a cry, the entity once informed him that he had lost control.}}
